title: the Old Mill House Rising
author: Ines Vane
blurb: Ines Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
